articles.title: Teenager Hannah Klugman Wins Her Biggest Tennis Title Yet
articles.summary: Hannah Klugman, 17, beat Elsa Jacquemot 6-2 6-4 to win her biggest tennis title yet, the W100 Lexus Wrexham Open, without losing a set all week.

articles.title: How a Unicorn Called Buddy Became a Surprise Movie Hit
articles.summary: Buddy, a horror comedy about a 1990s TV mascot with a dark side, became a surprise hit thanks to its emotional depth and a campaign that let audiences fall for the character first.

articles.title: Jay-Z Ends His Tour With Surprise Guests in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Jay-Z closed the Jay-Z 30 Tour at Los Angeles' SoFi Stadium with surprise guests Snoop Dogg, Dr. Dre, and Too Short, and a message to trust your own eyes and ears.
